description: SideBar item — the navigation row. lg-squared inset around an md compressed label (heights 40/52/60; the inset absorbs the half-leading), a swappable leading icon in the md cap cell, ghost ladder at rest, accent when selected (fill + strong underline ink + accent glyph/label), and a thin subtle underline as the list separator — items stack with no gap, the borders are the rhythm. Collapsed: an icon-only square (width = height = inset×2 + cap) — the icon centres itself, because (height − glyph)/2 = inset − (glyph − cap)/2 is an identity of the optical system. Has Menu: a chevron trails when expanded; a small corner flag (bottom-right) marks the submenu when collapsed.
notes: v0.1.0 (2026-09-05, Victor's sidebar review; sources: Component Mocks 714-629 and the colour-tutorial application mock — both older geometry, corrected here to the ladder). Collapsed is a VARIANT (iconOnly structure — the Ghost-icon precedent), not a state: hover and selected still exist while collapsed. The chevron flip on open (accordion) and the Collapse item's first_page↔last_page swap are interaction facts, recorded not built — round B. Chevron key is the EDS Assets SET key; the builder resolves set keys to their default variant. Same day: collapsed gained code-side CASCADE (inherit) — one data-collapsed on the rail collapses every item; Figma cannot reach consumer slot content (the slots model: instance content is the instance's own), so baked defaults mirror and edited slots flip WITH the rail (multi-select) — recorded LOWERED. v0.2.0: Label ink nudged strong → SUBTLE (2026-09-05, Victor — 'will look better'): menu labels are SCANNED (md compressed), floor Lc 60; measured live via apca-w3: subtle at rest = 84.7 light / −86.1 dark on surface, −69.1 on the dark floating panel (the tightest real case, above the floor); hover 67/−69. Selected keeps text-accent-strong — the 60.4 corner never occurs. Accepted trade: label and icon now share step 12, flattening the strong-text/subtle-icon hierarchy for nav rows — quieter chrome, deliberate.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: The sidebar's rail state, mirrored onto its items: icon-only square, label and chevron gone, the flag marks a submenu.

props.name: hasMenu
props.description: The item opens a submenu: chevron when expanded, corner flag when collapsed.

aria.aria-current: page on the selected item; aria-expanded on items with a submenu
